subject: general
question: Which of the following labs under the Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO), successfully conducted high-altitude trials of the Indigenous On-Board Oxygen Generating System (OBOGS)-based Integrated Life Support System (ILSS) for the LCA Tejas aircraft, on March 04, 2025?

options.text: Aerial Delivery Research and Development Establishment (ADRDE)

solution:
The correct answer is __**Defence Bio-Engineering & Electro Medical Laboratory (DEBEL)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Defence Bio-Engineering & Electro Medical Laboratory (DEBEL)**, located in Bengaluru, successfully conducted high-altitude trials of the **Indigenous On-Board Oxygen Generating System (OBOGS)-based Integrated Life Support System (ILSS)** for the **LCA Tejas aircraft** on **March 04, 2025**.
 
• The **Integrated Life Support System (ILSS)** is designed to enhance the operational capability of fighter aircraft pilots by generating oxygen onboard during high-altitude flights.
 
• The OBOGS technology eliminates the need for traditional oxygen cylinders, making the system more **efficient, lightweight, and safer** for fighter aircraft operations.
 
• The trials conducted by DEBEL were crucial for validating the performance and reliability of the system in extreme conditions, ensuring its suitability for deployment in the indigenous **LCA Tejas aircraft**.
 
• DEBEL specializes in the development of life support systems, biomedical devices, and protective equipment for the armed forces, playing a significant role in enhancing operational safety and efficiency.
